priority: reference interval printed in the case or source laboratory report
method-, specimen-, age-, and sex-matched interval
interpretation_policy.unit_rule: Only exact units or an explicitly listed same-analyte conversion may be compared. Incompatible or unqualified units return unknown.
interpretation_policy.caution: Reference intervals vary by laboratory, population, specimen, method, age, sex, pregnancy status, and clinical purpose. These data are for benchmark normalization and research, not patient care.
interpretation_policy.legacy_note: Entries whose source IDs do not end in _2026 were already present in the frozen catalog and are retained for backward compatibility. The 2026 extension does not claim to have re-derived those legacy limits.

Tietz 5th Ed.title: Tietz Textbook of Clinical Chemistry and Molecular Diagnostics
Tietz 5th Ed.use: Legacy source recorded by the pre-existing catalog; values retained for backward compatibility and not re-derived in this extension.

ATP III.title: Third Report of the NCEP Expert Panel (Adult Treatment Panel III), Final Report
ATP III.publisher: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
ATP III.use: Legacy lipid decision limits recorded by the pre-existing catalog; retained for backward compatibility.

ADA 2023.title: Classification and Diagnosis of Diabetes: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2023
ADA 2023.use: Legacy fasting-glucose and HbA1c limits recorded by the pre-existing catalog; retained for backward compatibility.

AUA 2023.title: Early Detection of Prostate Cancer: AUA/SUO Guideline
AUA 2023.use: Legacy PSA source label recorded by the pre-existing catalog. PSA thresholds are context-dependent; the value is retained only for backward compatibility.

KDIGO 2012.title: KDIGO 2012 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
KDIGO 2012.use: Legacy GFR source recorded by the pre-existing catalog; retained for backward compatibility.

Endocrine Society 2011.title: Evaluation, Treatment, and Prevention of Vitamin D Deficiency
Endocrine Society 2011.version: 2011; superseded for disease prevention by the 2024 guideline
Endocrine Society 2011.use: Legacy vitamin-D interval recorded by the pre-existing catalog. The 2024 guideline no longer endorses a universal target for healthy adults; retained only for backward compatibility.

NBME_2026.title: NBME Laboratory Values
NBME_2026.use: Primary conventional and SI adult fallback intervals for common chemistry, hematology, arterial blood gas, CSF, thyroid, iron, and immunoglobulin tests.

ABIM_2026.title: ABIM Laboratory Test Reference Ranges
ABIM_2026.use: Adult fallback intervals and explicitly stratified decision limits absent from NBME, including complement, tumor markers, high-sensitivity troponin, hormones, and NT-proBNP.

MSD_2026.title: Laboratory Reference Ranges
MSD_2026.use: Cross-check and policy support: reporting-laboratory intervals supersede generalized tables.

MAYO_DDIMER_FEU.title: D-Dimer, Plasma (DIMER)
MAYO_DDIMER_FEU.use: Method-specific FEU cutoff of 500 ng/mL for citrated plasma.

MAYO_IGG4.title: IgG4, Immunoglobulin Subclasses, Serum (IGGS4)
MAYO_IGG4.use: Method-specific adult serum IgG4 interval of 2.4-121.0 mg/dL and LOINC 2469-5.

MAYO_MERCURY_BLOOD.title: Mercury, Blood (HG)
MAYO_MERCURY_BLOOD.use: Whole-blood mercury method and reference value below 10 ng/mL (numerically equivalent to μg/L).

ASH_DDIMER_UNITS.title: COVID-19 and D-dimer: Frequently Asked Questions
ASH_DDIMER_UNITS.use: Safety rule: keep FEU and DDU distinct and do not convert between them without assay validation.

NHS_UREA.title: Urea
NHS_UREA.publisher: North Bristol NHS Trust, Severn Pathology
NHS_UREA.use: Adult serum/plasma urea fallback interval of 2.5-7.8 mmol/L.

LOINC_2_82.title: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes
LOINC_2_82.use: Analyte, specimen, scale, method, and unit identity. LOINC does not supply universal reference intervals.

UCUM_2_2.title: Unified Code for Units of Measure Specification
UCUM_2_2.use: Canonical unit semantics and exact metric-prefix/volume conversions; analyte-specific molar-mass factors remain explicitly curated.

HPO_2026_06_23.title: Human Phenotype Ontology
HPO_2026_06_23.use: HPO labels corresponding to loinc2hpo identifiers.
